name: Two-tier app
description: A web server and a private database server that can find each other.

fields.startup_script:
#!/bin/sh
# Clutter puts the database server's private address in CLUTTER_DB_ADDRESS.
mkdir -p /etc/app
echo "DATABASE_HOST=$CLUTTER_DB_ADDRESS" > /etc/app/database.env
# Check that this server reaches the database server, and say so on the console.
result="web could not reach db"
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do
  if ping -c 1 -W 2 "$CLUTTER_DB_ADDRESS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    result="web reached db"
    break
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 5
done
echo "$result"
echo "$result" >/dev/console 2>/dev/null

#!/bin/sh
# Install PostgreSQL where the image has a package manager for it.
if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y postgresql15-server && postgresql-setup --initdb && systemctl enable --now postgresql
elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update && apt-get install -y postgresql
fi
